panels.title: Targets up
panels.description: How many Prometheus targets answered the last scrape. A drop means a service or exporter is down, not that a checkout failed.

panels.title: Request rate
panels.description: HTTP requests per second across the Java services and the gateway. This is traffic, not successful checkouts.

panels.title: 5xx rate
panels.description: Server error responses per second. A business rejection such as 409 or 429 is not included.

panels.title: Active sagas
panels.description: Orders still in PENDING_INVENTORY, PENDING_PAYMENT, PENDING_INVENTORY_COMMIT, or COMPENSATING.

panels.title: Request rate by service
panels.description: Throughput for each scraped Java service. The job label is the service name, never a customer or order id.

panels.title: Process memory
panels.description: Resident memory reported by each process. Compare it with the container limit before raising replica count.
